definitions.short: El-Paran , a portion of the district of Paran
definitions.full: H364. El Paran מָּארָן אֵיל proper name, of a location ( terebinth (or palm ? see Di) of Paran ) town & harbour at head of lanitic Gulf Gen 14:6 (see Di); = אֵלָה 36:41 ; אֵילַת Deut 2:8 ; 2Kin 14:22 ; 16:6 ; אֵילוֺת 1Kin 9:26 ; 2Kin 16:6 ; close to Ezion Geber (see גֶּבֶר עֶצְיוֺן ).
